claim_text: Architected a governed policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows, combining L0 route-policy dispatch, multi-agent orchestration contracts, and human override escalation paths for regulated deployments.
Built CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing enterprise workflow adoption with usage-based subscription forecasting to sustain renewal growth.
Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by embedding context engineering and runtime resilience controls across evaluation gates and rollback pathways.

Standardized the AI systems lifecycle to compress deployment from six months to three weeks, applying managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design across intake, validation, and monitoring stages.

Established high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating Databricks Lakehouse pipelines with dense sparse exact retrieval design and provider egress governance.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while advancing agentic platform productization and an operating model for agentic AI that converted delivery into reusable commercial IP.
